0.0.en: Xiao Yu began his university life with strong hopes for his [[education:education]], and learning English well was his [[primary:primary]] aim.
0.0.zh: 小宇满怀期待地开始了大学生活，把学好英语当作自己的首要目标。

0.1.en: Before that, he had studied at a noted [[secondary:secondary]] school near the new language [[institute:institute]] in town.
0.1.zh: 在那之前，他就读于镇上新办的语言学院附近一所很有名气的中学。

0.2.en: At the arts [[academy:academy]], he hoped to [[acquire:acquire]] skills that would serve him well in life.
0.2.zh: 在这所艺术学院里，他希望学到一些将来能派上用场的技能。

0.3.en: On Monday morning, teachers with real [[expertise:expertise]] welcomed every nervous [[novice:novice]] at the gate.
0.3.zh: 周一早晨，经验丰富的老师们在大门口迎接每一位紧张的新生。

0.4.en: Around them, clubs were busy trying to [[recruit:recruit]] new members, hoping to find students confident and fully [[literate:literate]] in English.
0.4.zh: 周围的社团忙着招新，希望找到自信、英语读写都过关的新成员。

0.5.en: That afternoon, a talk on ending [[illiteracy:illiteracy]] showed how adult classes helped workers who were not yet [[numerate:numerate]].
0.5.zh: 当天下午，一场关于消除文盲的讲座，讲的是成人班如何帮助那些还不识数的工人。

1.0.en: The welcome party was a cheerful [[affair:affair]], with no [[controversial:controversial]] speeches or heated debates.
1.0.zh: 迎新晚会办得轻松愉快，没有任何有争议的发言或激烈的争论。

1.1.en: During a party game, Xiao Yu had to solve a tricky [[puzzle:puzzle]] and then guess a funny word [[riddle:riddle]].
1.1.zh: 在晚会游戏里，小宇要先解开一道伤脑筋的谜题，再猜一个有趣的字谜。

1.2.en: One rule seemed [[obscure:obscure]] at [[first:first]], but patient teachers helped [[instil:instil]] good study habits in everyone.
1.2.zh: 有一条规则起初显得不清楚，但耐心的老师慢慢向大家灌输好的学习习惯。

1.3.en: From that day on, he refused to [[cram:cram]] late at [[night:night]], because his advisers always [[emphasise:emphasised]] calm, regular work.
1.3.zh: 从那天起，他不肯在深夜临时抱佛脚，因为辅导员总强调要从容而有规律地学习。

1.4.en: Morning runs would [[enhance:enhance]] his energy and [[enable:enable]] him to stay sharp in class.
1.4.zh: 晨跑能让他精力更足，上课时也能保持清醒。

1.5.en: A kind roommate would [[inspire:inspire]] him on low days, and that friendship became his main [[motive:motive]] for working hard.
1.5.zh: 心地好的室友总在他低落时给他打气，这份友谊也成了他努力用功的主要动机。

2.0.en: Their long talks would [[motivate:motivate]] Xiao Yu and [[stimulate:stimulate]] his curiosity about reading.
2.0.zh: 他们的长谈会激励小宇，也勾起他对阅读的好奇心。

2.1.en: A small win in English gave him both a useful [[spur:spur]] and fresh [[impetus:impetus]] for harder tasks.
2.1.zh: 英语上的一次小胜利，既鞭策了他，也给了他挑战更难任务的干劲。

2.2.en: Even so, he never [[indulge:indulged]] in late-night games that could [[spoil:spoil]] his sleep and mood.
2.2.zh: 尽管如此，他从不沉溺于深夜游戏，那会毁掉他的睡眠和心情。

2.3.en: His roommate was highly [[intelligent:intelligent]] and always found [[clever:clever]] ways to remember new words.
2.3.zh: 他的室友非常聪明，总能想出巧妙的办法记住新单词。

2.4.en: Xiao Yu himself looked [[smart:smart]] in blue jeans and showed [[all round:all-round]] talent in music and sports.
2.4.zh: 小宇自己穿着蓝色牛仔裤显得很精神，在音乐和运动上也展现了多方面的才华。

2.5.en: No one called him a [[genius:genius]], yet he trained with the [[elite:elite]] runners every [[dawn:dawn]] on the track.
2.5.zh: 没人叫他天才，但每天黎明他都和精英跑者一起在跑道上训练。

3.0.en: He never felt like an [[idiot:idiot]] because older students shared their practical [[wisdom:wisdom]] with him every day.
3.0.zh: 高年级同学每天都和他分享实用的经验，他从不觉得自己是笨蛋。

3.1.en: Blessed with quick [[wit:wit]] and a [[natural:natural]] [[aptitude:aptitude]] for sounds, he loved practising speaking out loud.
3.1.zh: 他反应机智，对语音又有天生的敏锐，所以特别喜欢大声练口语。

3.2.en: Soon he felt [[capable:capable]] of doing [[outstanding:outstanding]] work in group discussions.
3.2.zh: 很快他就相信自己能在小组讨论里拿出出色的表现。

3.3.en: Then a visitor gave a [[brilliant:brilliant]] talk, which added to the [[prestige:prestige]] of the English evening.
3.3.zh: 后来一位来宾做了场精彩的演讲，让英语之夜更有声望了。

3.4.en: After that event, the club built a solid [[reputation:reputation]] by inviting an [[eminent:eminent]] visitor from Beijing.
3.4.zh: 那次活动之后，社团又请来一位北京的杰出访客，名声渐渐传开。

3.5.en: Even a student [[notorious:notorious]] for sleeping late earned everyone's [[esteem:esteem]] after helping them move rooms.
3.5.zh: 连那个出了名爱睡懒觉的同学，在帮大家搬完宿舍后也赢得了众人的尊敬。

4.0.en: Xiao Yu stayed [[diligent:diligent]], taking [[painstaking:painstaking]] care over his notes in every grammar lesson.
4.0.zh: 小宇始终勤奋，每节语法课都一丝不苟地记好笔记。

4.1.en: His simple [[approach:approach]] was to follow a weekly study [[scheme:scheme]] drawn up with friends.
4.1.zh: 他的方法很简单：照着和朋友一起订的周学习计划走。

4.2.en: The kind [[headmaster:headmaster]] welcomed the parents warmly, while the assistant [[principal:principal]] shook hands with everyone.
4.2.zh: 和蔼的校长热情欢迎家长，副校长则挨个和大家握手。

4.3.en: Next, the busy [[dean:dean]] stood at the podium and introduced new teachers from every [[faculty:faculty]].
4.3.zh: 接着，忙碌的院长站在讲台上，介绍了各个院系新来的老师。

4.4.en: One old [[professor:professor]] and a young visiting [[scholar:scholar]] patiently answered all the questions.
4.4.zh: 一位老教授和一位年轻的访问学者耐心回答了大家的问题。

4.5.en: Later, a friendly [[scientist:scientist]] and his kind English [[tutor:tutor]] even joined the outing by the lake.
4.5.zh: 后来，一位友善的科学家和他和蔼的英语导师还参加了湖边出游。

5.0.en: A funny [[lecturer:lecturer]] and her cheerful [[assistant:assistant]] showed short videos about city life.
5.0.zh: 一位风趣的讲师和她开朗的助手播放了关于城市生活的短视频。

5.1.en: As the class [[candidate:candidate]], Xiao Yu trained hard to [[qualify:qualify]] for the speech competition finals.
5.1.zh: 作为班级选出的选手，小宇刻苦训练，只为拿到演讲比赛的决赛资格。

5.2.en: The school office would [[certify:certify]] his hours, then hand him a [[diploma:diploma]] complete with seals.
5.2.zh: 学校办公室会核实他的学时，之后发给他一张盖着章的文凭。

5.3.en: A retired [[diplomat:diplomat]] and a cultural [[ambassador:ambassador]] came to talk about travel and good manners.
5.3.zh: 一位退休外交官和一位文化大使来讲旅行与礼貌礼节。

5.4.en: A visiting [[pupil:pupil]] asked a recent [[graduate:graduate]] how to pick good books for teenagers.
5.4.zh: 一个来参观的小学生问一位刚毕业的学长：怎么给青少年挑好书。

5.5.en: At the opening [[ceremony:ceremony]], a young [[bachelor:bachelor]] sang a warm song about home.
5.5.zh: 在开学典礼上，一位年轻的学士唱了一首关于家的温暖歌曲。

6.0.en: He hoped to [[master:master]] everyday English as a confident college [[fresher:fresher]] that autumn.
6.0.zh: 那年秋天，作为一名自信的大一新生，他希望掌握日常英语。

6.1.en: A helpful [[sophomore:sophomore]] and a shy [[junior:junior]] showed him the skating rink and the shops nearby.
6.1.zh: 一位热心的大二学生和一个害羞的大三学生，带他去看了溜冰场和附近的商店。

6.2.en: A calm [[senior:senior]] told stories of [[alumni:alumni]] who now worked in other cities.
6.2.zh: 一位沉稳的大四学生，讲起那些如今在别的城市工作的校友的故事。

6.3.en: During [[campus:campus]] walks, the short [[orientation:orientation]] week helped him feel calm and safe.
6.3.zh: 校园散步途中，短短的迎新周让他渐渐感到平静安心。

6.4.en: On the hall steps, staff demonstrated a new online learning [[platform:platform]] to students from the [[coed:coed]] dorms.
6.4.zh: 在大楼台阶上，工作人员向住在男女合宿宿舍的学生们演示了新的在线学习平台。

6.5.en: Every morning, he helped teachers [[register:register]] names and check the printed class [[roster:roster]].
6.5.zh: 每天早晨，他都帮老师登记名字，核对打印出来的班级花名册。

7.0.en: He chose to [[enrol:enrol]] in two clubs before handing in his final [[matriculation:matriculation]] forms.
7.0.zh: 交最后的入学登记表之前，他就先报名加入了两个社团。

7.1.en: His new [[accommodation:accommodation]] was a small shared [[dorm:dorm]] with bright windows and overhead fans.
7.1.zh: 他的新住处是一间带明亮窗户和吊扇的小合住宿舍。

7.2.en: At noon, the crowded [[dining hall:dining hall]] felt warmer than the little street [[canteen:canteen]] nearby.
7.2.zh: 中午时，拥挤的大食堂比附近的小街餐馆更让人觉得温暖。

7.3.en: In the white [[laboratory:laboratory]], he watched a simple, safe [[experiment:experiment]] with great care.
7.3.zh: 在白色实验室里，他目不转睛地看着一个简单安全的实验。

7.4.en: For homework, he copied key [[data:data]] on food prices and checked each [[quantity:quantity]] twice.
7.4.zh: 做作业时，他抄下食品价格的关键数据，并把每个数量核对两遍。

7.5.en: He cared about the [[quality:quality]] of his study spot, always taking the [[quiet:quiet]] corner of the tall old [[library:library]].
7.5.zh: 他很在意学习角落的品质，总爱占老图书馆里最安静的那个角落。

8.0.en: For his English [[literature:literature]] class, he read a short, funny [[article:article]] about weekends.
8.0.zh: 英语文学课上，他读了一篇关于周末的短小有趣的文章。

8.1.en: The kind [[author:author]] also shared an old family [[tale:tale]] about crossing rivers by boat.
8.1.zh: 那位和蔼的作者还分享了一个祖辈乘船过河的古老家族传说。

8.2.en: He borrowed a science [[fiction:fiction]] book and finished the whole [[story:story]] in two nights.
8.2.zh: 他借了一本科幻小说，两个晚上就把整个故事读完了。

8.3.en: He kept a small [[diary:diary]] and copied out a verse of love [[poetry:poetry]] every Sunday.
8.3.zh: 他坚持记日记，每个星期天抄一段爱情诗。

8.4.en: He bought a cheap sports [[magazine:magazine]] and wrote notes in a blue class [[journal:journal]] daily.
8.4.zh: 他买了一本便宜的体育杂志，每天在蓝色的班级日志里写笔记。

8.5.en: The small [[coverage lettering:coverage lettering]] on his map even carried a short reading [[bibliography:bibliography]] below.
8.5.zh: 他地图上那些细小的覆盖标注下面，甚至配了一份简短的阅读书目。

9.0.en: [[opening:Opening]] a thick [[encyclopedia:encyclopedia]], he then consulted a short photo [[biography:biography]] of a sculptor.
9.0.zh: 他翻开一本厚厚的百科全书，又查阅了一本雕塑家的短篇图片传记。

9.1.en: He kept a neat study [[record:record]], with each sheet saved in a yellow [[file:file]] folder.
9.1.zh: 他的学习记录记得整整齐齐，每一页都收在黄色文件夹里。

9.2.en: While writing a short self [[profile:profile]], he felt a cold [[night:night]] [[draught:draught]] through the cracked window.
9.2.zh: 写简短的自我简介时，他感到夜风正从裂了缝的窗缝里灌进来。

9.3.en: He drew a quick [[sketch:sketch]] of the room, then picked up a travel [[brochure:brochure]] from the desk.
9.3.zh: 他飞快画了张房间草图，又从桌上拿起一本旅行小册子。

9.4.en: Later he read the bike repair [[manual:manual]] and fixed the bent [[frame:frame]] with tools.
9.4.zh: 之后他读完自行车修理手册，用工具把弯了的车架修好。

9.5.en: For help, he checked the book [[index:index]] and the rows of the old [[wooden:wooden]] [[card catalogue:card catalogue]].
9.5.zh: 他还翻了翻书后索引和那排旧木卡片目录，想找点线索。

10.0.en: He sorted snacks by [[category:category]] and made a small shop [[inventory:inventory]] for his roommates.
10.0.zh: 他把零食分门别类，还为室友做了一份小卖部式存货清单。

10.1.en: Before morning talks, he previewed the lesson [[content:content]] to grasp the [[context:context]] of each new word.
10.1.zh: 早晨会话练习前，他先预习课文内容，弄懂每个新词的语境。

10.2.en: He made a new verb [[list:list]] and reviewed one more grammar [[chapter:chapter]] after dinner.
10.2.zh: 他列了张新的动词清单，晚饭后又复习了一章语法。

10.3.en: After a quick [[sketch:sketch]] of his room, he turned the music [[volume:volume]] down and tackled a hard new [[subject:subject]] on city rivers.
10.3.zh: 飞快给房间画了张草图后，他调低音乐音量，啃起那门讲城市河流的难课。

10.4.en: He chose English as his [[major:major]] and music as his [[minor:minor]] for the [[first:first]] year.
10.4.zh: 第一学年，他选英语作主修，音乐作辅修。

10.5.en: An easy [[sociology:sociology]] video and a short [[politics:politics]] talk filled his free evenings.
10.5.zh: 一段轻松的社会学视频和一场简短的政治讲座，填满了他空闲的夜晚。

11.0.en: Basic [[economics:economics]] lessons and a simple [[marketing:marketing]] game made Friday classes vibrant.
11.0.zh: 基础经济学课加简单的营销游戏，让周五的课堂活力十足。

11.1.en: An [[accounting:accounting]] friend showed him the books before the in-house cash [[audit:audit]] at noon.
11.1.zh: 中午内部现金查账前，一位会计专业的朋友给他看了账本。

11.2.en: Simple [[statistics:statistics]] charts and basic [[psychology:psychology]] tips helped him plan his sleep better.
11.2.zh: 简单的统计图表和基础心理学建议，帮他更好地规划睡眠。

11.3.en: A short maxim from [[philosophy:philosophy]] and one clear [[logic:logic]] task sharpened his morning thinking.
11.3.zh: 一句哲学短箴言加一道清晰的逻辑题，让他早晨的思路更敏锐。

11.4.en: A fun [[physics:physics]] demo and a visit to a city [[agriculture:agriculture]] project filled his Saturday morning.
11.4.zh: 好玩的物理演示加上参观城里的农业项目，占满了他周六上午。

11.5.en: A talk on city [[logistics:logistics]] and a colourful [[geography:geography]] map wrapped up the busy week.
11.5.zh: 一场城市物流讲座和一张彩色地理地图，为忙碌的一周收尾。

paraZh.0: 小宇满怀期待入学，把学好英语定为首要目标。
paraZh.1: 迎新晚会轻松愉快，他定下规律作息找到动力。
paraZh.2: 长谈激励着他，小宇自律多才，黎明随精英晨练。
paraZh.3: 他日渐自信，社团声望随之升高。
paraZh.4: 他勤奋记笔记，开学季结识众多师长。
paraZh.5: 他备战演讲赛，各方嘉宾让活动精彩。
paraZh.6: 学长学姐带他熟悉校园，注册井井有条。
paraZh.7: 他安顿宿舍，泡实验室与图书馆。
paraZh.8: 读小说抄诗记日志，阅读生活丰富。
paraZh.9: 查百科修自行车，自学本领样样上手。
paraZh.10: 列清单做预习选专业，每晚安排满满。
paraZh.11: 经济物理地理轮番上阵，一周充实收尾。
